sections.title: The Cool-Down Is Enough
sections.body: You do not need to translate the name or build a route around it. The value is a clean, cool stop when the day needs one.

sections.title: An Outdoor Edge Past The Traffic
sections.body: Yen Retreat is Da Nang's outdoor edge: lawn, river, simple tents, mountains, and breathing room beyond the dense beach-and-bridge loop.

sections.title: Rain Changes The Plan
sections.body: The riverside lawn feels unhurried in soft weather and messy after heavy rain. Sky, ground, and daylight decide how much outdoor time to give it.

sections.title: Uncrowded Outdoor Time
sections.body: Treat it as simple outdoor time instead of a checklist: walk a little, sit in the shade, notice the water and mountain line, then leave before it feels forced.

sections.title: Weather And Ride Margin
sections.body: Yen Retreat needs kind weather and an unhurried return. A stop this far out needs margin for rain, distance, and daylight.
